description: v6 — story-driven pools per Keith's framework. Pools map to actual auction-room stories (routine forced, high tension, late overtake/takeback, day-2 extender, Hawks mocking, franchise-pair rivalries) instead of generic emotion buckets. Worker evaluates scenarios in order; first scenario whose trigger matches AND survives probability_pct picks a GIF from its pool_id (rotated to avoid last 3 used).

schema_notes.pools: Named GIF buckets. Scenarios reference pools by id. A pool can be shared by multiple scenarios. Each entry: { url, label?, weight? }. Worker rotates: picks from (pool.gifs - last_3_used). Empty pools = scenario falls through to next scenario / Giphy fallback.
schema_notes.scenarios: Ordered priority list. Worker evaluates top-down; first scenario whose trigger matches AND survives probability_pct wins.

trigger_fields.actor_franchise_id: Single franchise id (4-digit) — actor of this event must match. Use for franchise-specific (Hawks)
trigger_fields.target_franchise_id: Single franchise id — the franchise whose lead is being affected (overtake target for overtakes, prior leader for forced increases). Use for rivalry pairs
trigger_fields.is_takeback: true if actor previously held the lead on this lot and is now reclaiming it after losing it
trigger_fields.min_same_fid_consecutive: Last N bids on lot are all from actor_fid

schema_notes.overlay_pool_id: Optional second GIF stacked on the first — used for headline+all-time tier
schema_notes.rotation: Module-scope Map<pool_id, [last_3_urls]>. Resets on worker cold-start.

_franchise_map._note: Display-only reference for scenario authors. Worker reads franchise ids from D1, not this block.
